risk_flags.reason: Sacred-table (questions) UPDATE and INSERT in the generate route. Both are within the DEC-V5-12 enumerated pre-approval: the UPDATE matches the exact retire scope (SET retired_at/retired_reason/is_retired WHERE block_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND retired_at IS NULL, inside the generate transaction) and the INSERT is owner-scoped replacement questions. No DELETE on questions exists anywhere in the route, and no other sacred-table statement appears. Logged for traceability, not escalated, per the enumerated pre-approval.

failure_classification.evidence: No prior failures recorded for NOTESV5-3 and no failures this turn; verification suite reports 18/18 pass at evidence/verification-suite-output.txt:34.

evidence.claim: Retire UPDATE on sacred table questions matches DEC-V5-12 exact scope (block_id + user_id + retired_at IS NULL, sets retired_at/retired_reason='block_regenerated'/is_retired=1) and runs inside the write transaction; no DELETE present.
Replacement-question INSERT is owner-scoped (user_id = userId, block_id from owner-scoped staleBlocks), matching the second DEC-V5-12 pre-approved item.
Stale-block selection uses the required deterministic order (stale_since ASC, sealed_at ASC, id ASC) limited to 5, owner-scoped (document_id = id AND user_id = userId).
AI calls run before any transaction is opened; a hard failure is caught and returns 502 with zero DB writes (transaction not yet started), satisfying criterion 2.

All writes execute inside one db.transaction('write'); the only conditional (version bump) checks rowsAffected !== 1 and rolls back the whole transaction with a 409, satisfying criterion 4; no question row is deleted, session_answers untouched by construction (criteria 3,5).

Verification suite ran and is evidenced: 18/18 checks pass including retire-not-delete invariants (0 questions deleted), cross-user scoping, rollback atomicity on forced version conflict, 502 AI-failure path with unchanged counts, and blast-radius counts showing session_answers/study_sessions/question_feedback unchanged.
Register holds only RISK-0201 (P3, open); no open P0/P1 blocks a done verdict.
